purpose: Fill high-value regional skilling gaps missing from progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-2026-07-25: consumable skilling tools, named Daemonheim permanent unlocks, Seren skilling prayer, diary utility, Orthen/Tirannwn smithing stack pressure, and Havenhythe ritual ring.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. required_regions is only used when both regions are needed for a full stack, not for dual dig-site claims. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.

activity_additions.name: Skillchompa Hunter and Player-Owned Farm supply
requirements: 27+ Hunter for cobalt skillchompas (higher tiers scale to 97 Hunter for crystal)
Box traps for wild catches
Player-Owned Farm / Manor Farm access for chinchompa produce path
unlocks: Cobalt through crystal skillchompa tiers as stackable consumable skilling tools
Self-supplied skillchompas from Hunter catch sites and Manor Farm produce
Crystal skillchompa tier via Tirannwn catch / farm path
activity_additions.notes: Skillchompas are used for Archaeology, Divination, Fishing, Mining and Woodcutting. Cobalt wild catches sit at the Tree Gnome Stronghold Hunter area (Kandarin). Manor Farm in Kandarin is the durable self-supply loop for ironman planning. Crystal-tier supply pressures Tirannwn. Do not invent XP/hour figures for skillchompa methods here.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Kandarin is the practical supply hub via Hunter and POF. Crystal tier is a Tirannwn pressure, not a second Kandarin-only claim.

activity_additions.name: Bait and Switch (Evil Bob's Catspaw)
requirements: 99 Archaeology for the normal death-mask unlock path
Death mask artefact (normal source: Orthen Dig Site)
Catspeak amulet, catspeak amulet (e), or cramulet to speak with Bob the cat
2,000 chronotes and 100 monolith energy to harness after unlock
unlocks: Bait and Switch relic power at the mysterious monolith
Compatible fish auto-cooked on catch with half Cooking XP and no burns
Porter-compatible cooked fish bank transport after cook
activity_additions.notes: Unlock item is Evil Bob's Catspaw from offering a death mask to Bob the cat. Death mask does not require dual dig sites; Orthen on Anachronia is the normal self-sufficient source. Exclusions include Arc fish, divine locations, Daemonheim vile fish, and uncookable catches such as crystal urchins.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Anachronia / Orthen is the regional dependency for the normal unlock path. Monolith energy and chronotes remain global Archaeology systems.

activity_additions.name: Superheat Form (Seren prayer)
requirements: The Light Within completed in the normal game
91 Prayer
Ancient Curses book unlocked
unlocks: Auto-burn chopped logs for Firemaking XP while Woodcutting
Smelting 0.6 seconds / 1 game tick faster (including corrupted ore)
Smithing low heat treated as medium heat and medium heat treated as high heat
activity_additions.notes: This is a Seren / The Light Within skilling unlock, not a combat prayer. Drain is 100 prayer points per minute unless offset. Orthen furnace core fully negates Superheat Form drain when equipped before activating the prayer. Always Adze is a separate monolith alternative for log-burning without prayer drain.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Tirannwn owns the Light Within / Seren prayer unlock. Pair with Anachronia for Orthen furnace core when valuing sustained Superheat Form AFK smithing and firemaking.

equipment_additions.name: Skillchompas
requirements: Skill-specific level gates matching skillchompa tier (mithril through crystal tool tiers)
Hunter level 27/46/68/89/97 for cobalt/viridian/azure/crimson/crystal tiers
effects: Except Mining: +10% base XP on successful gather actions; 5% of a successful action as XP on failed attempts; one skillchompa consumed per XP grant
Archaeology: acts as a mattock (tier by skillchompa tier)
Woodcutting: acts as a hatchet (tier by skillchompa tier)
Mining: adds 30-70 critical-swing damage by tier while using a pickaxe; consumed on criticals; no direct Mining XP boost
Fishing: +1% catch rate per tier (1% cobalt through 5% crystal)
Divination: increased enriched-memory / critical harvest chance by tier
equipment_additions.notes: Wielded or backpack; wielded takes priority. POF perk If Chins Could Skill can save skillchompas. Supply is regional; the tools themselves are global once obtained.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Track Kandarin for practical mid-tier supply and Tirannwn for crystal tier. Do not invent League-specific catch rates.

equipment_additions.name: Ring of Kayazu
requirements: Moonrise Dig Site / Havenhythe Archaeology progression
88 Archaeology and 67 Crafting to assemble
Moonstone ring plus restored fang of Kayazu
The Final Revolution mystery solved
effects: Additive +80% soul attraction during rituals when worn
20% chance to double item rewards from ritual disturbances
equipment_additions.notes: Zero combat style bonuses. This is a ritual / Necromancy skilling ring from Moonrise Dig Site, not combat ring BiS. Do not rank it against combat rings.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Havenhythe owns Moonrise Dig Site. Keep ritual-utility framing only.

equipment_additions.name: Crystal hammer
requirements: Crystal tool seed
150 harmonic dust and 80 Smithing at the Ithell singing bowl, or NPC seed enchant with coins
Prifddinas / crystal-tool infrastructure
effects: +1% chance of double progress when smithing any core metal
3,000 strikes before reverting to seed unless augmented
Doubled chance of Smithing golden/strange rocks from Shattered Heart
equipment_additions.notes: Named crystal tool missing from the 2026-07-25 crystal-tool workshop row (that row listed pickaxe, hatchet, mattock, rod, tinderbox paths but not the hammer explicitly as equipment). Optimal Smithing stacks often pair augmented crystal hammer with Orthen furnace core and Superheat Form.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Tirannwn crystal-tool infrastructure. Harmonic dust and seed supply remain Prifddinas-gated.

equipment_additions.name: Scroll of cleansing
requirements: 49 Herblore
49 Dungeoneering
20,000 Dungeoneering tokens at Daemonheim Rewards
effects: Permanent Wasteless Herblore trait after reading
1 in 8 (12.5%) chance to mix the next queued potion one tick faster
1 in 10 (10%) chance to save a secondary ingredient (including clean herbs when making unfinished potions)
equipment_additions.notes: Explicit named Daemonheim reward. Must not stay buried inside the generic forinthry:daemonheim-skilling-rewards bundle. Does not affect tea or herb tars. Over long runs, secondary savings yield more potions per ingredient stock.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry dependency via Daemonheim. Token costs stay at wiki values unless Equilibrium publishes a multiplier.

equipment_additions.name: Smithing autoheater
requirements: 35 Smithing and 35 Dungeoneering for base autoheater (4,000 tokens)
70 Smithing and 70 Dungeoneering plus base autoheater for advanced upgrade (40,000 tokens)
effects: Base: on 0% heat, consumes 5 coal from metal bank to restore 30% heat
Advanced overheat mode: on 0% heat, consumes 50 coal to restore 60% heat
Enables AFK low/medium heat smithing without manual reheating
equipment_additions.notes: Named Forinthry / Daemonheim Smithing unlock. With Superheat Form, low/medium heat is promoted so autoheater plus Superheat Form can hold medium-high heat AFK. Complements Orthen furnace core rather than replacing it.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Hard Forinthry dependency. Track base and advanced as two milestones.

equipment_additions.name: Orthen furnace core full skilling stack
requirements: 99 Smithing and 102 Archaeology to craft the Orthen furnace core
Four restored dragon burners from Orthen Observation outpost excavation (Anachronia)
Superheat Form from The Light Within / Seren prayers (Tirannwn)
Crystal hammer from Prifddinas crystal-tool infrastructure (Tirannwn) for the full named tool half of the stack
effects: Orthen furnace core off-hand: negates Superheat Form prayer drain when equipped before activating the prayer
Superheat Form: auto-burn logs while Woodcutting; faster smelting; promoted smithing heat bands
Crystal hammer: +1% double smithing progress and augmentable Invention perks
Furnace core plus autoheater plus Superheat Form enables fully AFK medium-high heat smithing
region_pressure: Anachronia owns Orthen Dig Site dragon burners and the furnace-core craft side.
Tirannwn owns Superheat Form and crystal hammer; it does not own Orthen dig-site artefacts.
Do not claim dual dig sites: Orthen is Anachronia-only in this chain.
equipment_additions.notes: UPDATE-style companion to anachronia:orthen-furnace-core. That single-region row still tracks the item obtain. This stack row records Anachronia+Tirannwn combo pressure for planners valuing sustained Superheat Form smithing/firemaking. Smithing autoheater (Forinthry) is a strong third-region AFK partner but is not required to name the Anachronia+Tirannwn core stack.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Surface Anachronia plus Tirannwn together when ranking late-game smithing/firemaking QoL. Never imply Moonrise or a second dig site is part of this stack.
